description: This PHP class defines a console command 'projectwatch' for the Goteo platform, used to trigger project-related events such as publishing, ending rounds, activation, and watching projects, primarily for notification or automation purposes.

classes.name: ProjectWatcherCommand
classes.description: A console command class for managing project event notifications in Goteo.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command name, description, options, and help text.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command, triggering project events based on project status and options.
